notes.title: Robowars re-released on Steam!
New Update is Available
notes.content:
An update has been uploaded for the game. We hope you enjoy it. Thanks for your continued support.

Patch Notes:
[list]
    [*]Problem with store interface when switching profiles fixed
    [*]Improved balance of missions
    [*]Improved tutorial
    [*]Improved cards selection interface in battle mode
    [*]Fixed a few non-critical bugs
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Problem with store interface when switching profiles fixed

tags.feature: [*]Improved cards selection interface in battle mode
